title: Your AI Bosses Are Still Prejudiced: The Emergence of Stereotypes in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent workplace interactions using neutral numerical agent identifiers and measuring spontaneous person-job associations using custom metrics like the Role Stereotyping Index (RSI), Group Bias Coefficient (GBC), and Competence Attribution Index (CAI).

Conducting an ablation study that replaces neutral numerical agent identifiers with specific names and profiles containing age, gender, and physical appearance descriptions to evaluate pre-existing person-job stereotypes inherited from LLM training data.
